checks.name: Manual verification: reject non-finite numeric input at /calculate, /memory/add, /memory/subtract
checks.detail: Started requestListener from src/server.ts via createServer(...).listen(0) on an ephemeral port (pattern from tests/http/server.test.ts) and drove it with real HTTP requests via a throwaway tsx script (not committed to the repo). Results: (1) POST /calculate {op:add,a:1e400,b:1} -> 400 {"error":"invalid request: require op, a, b"} (previously 200 {"result":null} before the fix). (2) POST /memory/add {value:1e400} -> 400 {"error":"invalid request: require value"} (previously 200 {"memory":null}). (3) POST /calculate {op:add,a:2,b:3} (normal, unaffected request) -> 200 {"result":5}, confirming the fix did not break the ordinary path. (4) Additionally checked POST /memory/subtract {value:1e400} -> 400 {"error":"invalid request: require value"}, covering the third handler the implementer changed. All four responses matched the expected shape and status exactly.
